outcomes.label: Meeting / call at a set time

stages.name: Opening
stages.purpose: Reach the right person and say who you are.
may_say: I no longer work there.
Who is this calling from?
That person does not sit here / wrong number.
I am busy right now.

stages.name: Purpose
stages.purpose: Say why you called in one or two sentences they could repeat to a colleague.
may_say: What is this regarding?
What is a growth report?
Where did you get my number?
Why are you doing this for free?
taps: Said it is a sales call

stages.name: Permission
stages.purpose: Find out if they can talk now: a clear yes, no, or a time to call back.
may_say: Yes, go ahead.
Call me tomorrow / after 3 PM.
Send it on WhatsApp or email first.
I am driving / travelling.

stages.name: Their business
stages.purpose: Ask about their company and work before saying more about yours.
may_say: One-line answer, then waits for the pitch.
We do not do that / that is another division.
You tell me about yourself first.

stages.name: Their need
stages.purpose: Hear what they are trying to do, in their own words. Write down exactly what they say.
may_say: A goal: revenue, profitability, skilled manpower, new products.
We are fine as we are.
We handle all of that in-house.
What can you do for a company like ours?

stages.name: Objection
stages.purpose: Understand the reason behind a no. A reason you understand can be answered.
may_say: I am not the right person / decisions are made elsewhere.
Send it in writing first.
We have our own team or consultant.
Not interested right now.

stages.name: Next step
stages.purpose: Agree one concrete thing, with a named time or channel.
may_say: Send the details on WhatsApp / email.
Call me on a named day and time.
Speak to my colleague (with or without number).
I will look at it and revert.

stages.name: Close
stages.purpose: End clearly. Record the outcome, the next step and their words from stage 5.
may_say: Thank you, bye.
The line dropped or they hung up.
A polite goodbye after a no (still a no).
